title: Ombudsman to sign data-sharing deal with Customs in November
summary: MANILA — The Office of the Ombudsman is set to sign a data-sharing agreement with the Bureau of Customs (BOC) in November, Ombudsman Jesus Crispin Remulla said on Saturday.
